description: Schema-v1 indexing settings (ADR 0004 §5.3, A10). This ID is fixture-only; production requires an owner-controlled prefix.

main.description: The owner's indexing choice, written by the owner to their own repository at <prefix>.settings/self. indexing=disabled asks this AppView to delete its local copy of the owner's data and keep only a suppression marker; it does not erase public PDS records. Deleting the record, or indexing=enabled at a newer revision, reconnects through a fresh verified snapshot. The record itself is public.

indexing.description: disabled opts the repository out of indexing; enabled opts back in.

createdAt.description: Explicit UTC RFC3339, from 1970-01-01 through event receipt time plus 300 seconds inclusive.
